theme: Premium SaaS + Light 3D - Luxury Omakase meets Command Center
concept: A dual-identity platform: elegant, immersive, and sensory for the customer (like a high-end menu), and ruthlessly efficient, data-dense, and tactical for the staff/admin. Rejects standard SaaS blues in favor of warm, appetizing amber/coral on an espresso-dark base.

headings.usage: H1 to H3. Use tracking-tight for H1/H2. Projects heritage and fine dining elegance.

body.usage: All functional UI, dashboards, body text, forms. Clean, modern geometry.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers, floating navs, and spring modals. Must have backdrop-blur-xl, saturate-150, and a delicate 1px inner border. NEVER use purely transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.elevation: Layered via deep ambient shadow + crisp 1px border. shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] for cards.
visual_enhancers.radius: Consistent rounded radius system. rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for inner elements, rounded-full for pills/buttons.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Custom illustrated or beautifully composed typographic empty states. No default generic texts.

layouts.landing: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) mixed with immersive asymmetric scroll sections. Massive negative space (p-12, p-24).
layouts.customer_menu: Responsive masonry or dense grid for flashcards. Mobile-first bottom sheet for cart.
layouts.admin_dashboard: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Flat backgrounds with 1px border.
layouts.kds_system: Kanban style horizontal scrollable board (Incoming, Preparing, Ready, Served). Full viewport height.

shared_variants.flip_front: { initial: { rotateY: 0 }, hover: { rotateY: 180 }, transition: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 260, damping: 20 } }
shared_variants.flip_back: { initial: { rotateY: -180 }, hover: { rotateY: 0 }, transition: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 260, damping: 20 } }
shared_variants.lift: { rest: { y: 0, scale: 1 }, hover: { y: -8, scale: 1.02, boxShadow: '0 20px 40px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' } }
shared_variants.fade_in_up: { hidden: { y: 20, opacity: 0 }, visible: { y: 0, opacity: 1, transition: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 24 } } }

motion.flashcard_pattern: Requires wrapper with `perspective: 1000px`. Inner motion.div with `transform-style: preserve-3d`. Front/Back faces with `backface-visibility: hidden`.
motion.stepper: Animated width expansion for progress bars with count-up text for percentages.
motion.modals: Spring-in modals (scale from 0.95, opacity 0 -> scale 1, opacity 1).

components.flashcards: Universal primitive for this app. Menu items flip to reveal allergens/order button. KPI cards flip to reveal chart trends. Table maps flip to show order details.
components.forms: Use Shadcn customized for the theme. Inputs get a warm focus ring (ring-primary/50).
components.stepper: Used for Order Flow (Placed -> Preparing -> Ready -> Served). Animated line connecting active dot states.
components.kds_column: Kanban lane with auto-scrolling capabilities and drag/drop or tap-to-move interactions.
components.chatbot: Floating glass widget with staggered chat bubbles and Framer Motion layout animations.

accessibility.contrast: AA-compliant. Primary text >= 4.5:1 against backgrounds. Ensure amber/coral text variants meet 3:1 on dark backgrounds.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap Framer Motion configs with `useReducedMotion` hook. If true, disable flips/springs and rely on opacity fades.

react_three_fiber.implementation: Render a high-end 3D rotating dish or plate. Use `<Canvas>`, `<ambientLight>`, `<directionalLight>`, and `<OrbitControls enableZoom={false} autoRotate />`. Ensure scene has warm studio lighting (`drei` `<Environment preset="studio" />`) to prevent muddy renders. Add floating interactive particles around the dish.

image_urls.description: High-end yellow tapas on black plate

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize optical alignment and negative space. Use generous paddings (p-6, p-8, p-12).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on floating elements or navigation bars.
Implement the flashcard flip using `framer-motion` for Menu, Staff Table map, and Admin KPI cards. This is a core identity feature.
Build the 3D rotating hero using `react-three-fiber` and `@react-three/drei`. Supply adequate lighting so it doesn't look flat.
Ensure the KDS dashboard fits horizontally and prioritizes real-time visibility and status updates.
All headings must use Cormorant Garamond, all body text must use Outfit. Fetch via Google Fonts or standard imports.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Use the provided high-quality image URLs from the media section.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Specifically target opacity and transform.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep natural left-aligned reading flow.
Always use modern interactive button styles with hover/active states.
NEVER use emojis as icons. Use Lucide icons or Phosphor icons exclusively.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive components for testability.
Ensure sonner is used for all toasts and notifications.
All components must be .js/.jsx, strictly adhering to standard React structure.
